title: Swap K8s scoring backend to local MVP trusted-open mode

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Asana task: Swap backend to local MVP spoof backend (no authentication). Definition of done: K8s integration uses the local MVP spoof backend path. Authentication is not required for this backend in the target test/demo environment. Demo request/response succeeds against the spoof backend.

Plan:
1. Add PLEXUS_BACKEND_MODE and PLEXUS_PROXY_AUTH_MODE to graphql-proxy Helm ConfigMap template
2. Switch values-local.yaml from AppSync upstream to local/trusted_open mode
3. Add seeding step + smoke verification to setup_envoy_gateway_poc.sh
4. Update values-local.yaml.example with local MVP config option
